title: Detailed kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Kite body: diamond shape -->
  <polygon points='50,8 82,45 50,88 18,45' fill='#e63946' stroke='#ff7b8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Inner diamond panel -->
  <polygon points='50,20 72,45 50,76 28,45' fill='#f4a261' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Inner diamond panel 2 -->
  <polygon points='50,32 64,45 50,64 36,45' fill='#2a9d8f' stroke='#64dfd2' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Center jewel -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='5' fill='#e9c46a' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Horizontal spar -->
  <line x1='18' y1='45' x2='82' y2='45' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Vertical spar -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='88' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Crossing lines detail -->
  <line x1='28' y1='45' x2='72' y2='45' stroke='#64dfd2' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='50' y2='76' stroke='#64dfd2' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <!-- Corner accents -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='88' r='2.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#f4a261'/>
  <!-- Tail ribbons -->
  <path d='M50,88 Q55,92 52,96' stroke='#e63946' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M50,88 Q45,92 48,96' stroke='#2a9d8f' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Ribbon shapes -->
  <polygon points='50,88 54,92 50,94 46,92' fill='#e9c46a'/>
  <!-- Bow ribbon on tail -->
  <polygon points='50,93 56,90 56,96' fill='#f4a261' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <polygon points='50,93 44,90 44,96' fill='#f4a261' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='93' r='1.5' fill='#e63946'/>
  <!-- String to flyer -->
  <path d='M50,8 Q60,3 70,6' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='2,1'/>
  <path d='M70,6 Q80,10 85,20' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-dasharray='2,1'/>
  <!-- Small decorative dots on panels -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
</svg>
